summary.text: Derrick Coley is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 24, appointed in January 2026, and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career has been in government relations.

paragraphs.text: Coley earned a high school diploma from Suitland High School, a bachelor's degree in biology from North Carolina State University, and a master's degree in environmental policy from American University.

His career experience includes serving as a director of external affairs for the Maryland Higher Education Commission, a special assistant for government relations at Bowie State University, an organization manager and public affairs liaison for Prince George's County, and a staff associate for the United States Conference of Mayors.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed him to District 24 on January 12, 2026, to replace Jazz Lewis, and he assumed office on January 13, 2026.
